summary: The run closes with its record complete, so this submission is unchanged and I report where the investigation stands. Three defects were established with retained executions, each carrying the conditions and limits its witnesses support rather than a general claim. The startup replay: with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, NewRaft replays committed entries through a blocking send on the 128-slot FSM channel before the FSM goroutine exists, so a window above 128 batches (8192 FSM-bound entries at the default) cannot be drained and the constructor never returns — demonstrated at the boundary (128 batches return, 129 do not), with a real snapshot in place under the captured default snapshot settings, and with the blocked stack sitting in the replay path in the retained run. The confirmation contract: verifyLeader seeds its tally with the leader's own vote and increments it for every registered replication peer, nonvoters included, while the quorum it is compared against counts only voters, so a leader whose only reachable peer is a nonvoter is confirmed against a voter quorum — shown over twenty mixed-timer trials in which the confirmation outlived a competing leader's election every time and coincided with a commit index above the confirming leader's applied index in twelve of twelve, with the uniform case bounded down to a one-millisecond margin and the separating gate identified as the peers' known-leader refusal. The membership change: AddVoter installs the requested server as a Voter in one step against two published descriptions that promise staging, so adding a server that is not yet running can leave a single-voter cluster with no leader, no commits and no way back through the API until that server runs or an operator intervenes out of band. Against those sit four refuted suspicions and one excluded cause, each with the evidence that defeated it — the interrupted-transfer goroutine stranding (defeated by the buffered send), the stale TimeoutNow producer (no internal path), the VerifyLeader stale-read consequence (bounded by measurement and by source for uniform settings), and the replication backoff (capped and cleared, so not unbounded) — plus one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, one paused lead left with a source-level bound and an executable discriminator for the FSM-latency question, twelve registered questions answered, and no necessary gap outstanding. No requirement was weakened and no contrary evidence suppressed: each finding states what its receipts show, and every narrowing and every refutation is retained in the record.
